snippet: Figure 2: A Recursive Language Model (RLM) treats prompts as part of the environment. It loads the input prompt as a variable inside a Python REPL environment $ℰ$ and writes code to peek into, decompose, and invoke itself recursively over programmatic snippets of the variable.
